title: Accumulator pressure maintenance with lead/lag pumps and relief
nl_spec: A hydraulic accumulator is kept charged by two fixed-role pumps. The lead pump runs when Pressure falls below P_LEAD = 200 bar; the lag pump additionally runs when Pressure falls below P_LAG = 150 bar (staging is monotonic: the lag pump never runs unless the lead pump also runs). To prevent over-pressurization, whenever Pressure reaches P_MAX = 280 bar a ReliefValve opens and BOTH pumps are inhibited. (A direct-acting mechanical relief valve protects the accumulator independently of this PLC; ReliefValve here is a supplementary PLC-commanded dump/unload output, not the primary code-safety device.) The station runs only while Enable is TRUE. EStop is normally-closed (TRUE = healthy, FALSE = activated); when activated both pumps stop (the relief valve is a pressure-driven safety device and is not inhibited by E-stop). Use pure thresholds (no hysteresis). Write an IEC 61131-3 Structured Text PROGRAM named accumulator with inputs Pressure, Enable, EStop and outputs LeadPump, LagPump, ReliefValve.

interface.name: EStop
interface.description: Emergency stop, normally-closed: TRUE = healthy, FALSE = activated

safety_properties.nl: At or above the maximum pressure, both pumps are inhibited (no pumping into over-pressure).
Positive obligation: at or above the maximum pressure, the relief valve is open.
Monotonic staging: the lag pump never runs unless the lead pump also runs.
On emergency stop, both pumps are off.
Positive obligation: while healthy, enabled and pressure is critically low, the lead pump runs.
When the station is disabled (Enable = FALSE), both pumps are off.

scenarios.description: Over-pressure inhibits pumps and opens relief
Disable stops both pumps even at low pressure

notes: DRAFT - pending expert PLC review. NEW FAMILY: fixed-role lead/lag pressure maintenance with an over-pressure relief obligation. Distinct from the existing pump-alternation family (roles are FIXED by pressure band, not alternated on each start, and there is no start-counter). Two positive obligations (relief-on-overpressure, lead-on-critical-low). Pure thresholds, no hysteresis.
